Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position announced by Aligarh Muslim University in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in any subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations. Specific conditions apply to pre-2009 Ph.D. holders.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 500/- for General and OBC category candidates. SC/ST candidates also need to pay Rs. 500/-. However, PwBD candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) role at AMU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position at Aligarh Muslim University will primarily involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts at Aligarh Muslim University is strictly Online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official AMU website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position is Contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the university.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any specific age relaxation policies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the interview date for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position is scheduled to be held on 06th October 2026. Candidates shortlisted for the interview will be notified accordingly.
